cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Only six people cracked our supper-club invitation. Excellent: a more selective table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Five thought it was a puzzle night. They've cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Wonderful. We've filtered out everyone who wasn't committed to dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last one's the printer asking to be paid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An invitation-only dinner with our sole supplier. It's become a private partnership event.

mechanism: A interprets its pupil invitation failures as sophisticated audience selection, grading each smaller attendance as a more valuable exclusive event.
confusable: Not simply generic cheerfulness: each setback becomes a specific improvement in the scheme selectivity or purpose.
comparison: Concealment through visible help versus prestige through attrition.
